slides.title:
The Problem Statement
• Current physical surveillance systems rely heavily on manual monitoring.
• Existing AI tools in the market are often used in inefficient way.
Research Summary
Integration of face detection, face recognition, and AI features into a real-time web application to automate threat identification and security analytics.
slides.narration: On slide 2, we see that the current physical surveillance systems are mostly monitored manually. This means that human eyes are constantly looking at cameras to spot any suspicious activities. However, this is very inefficient. Imagine trying to find a needle in a haystack using only your eyes - it would take a long time and not be very accurate. Now, let's look at how artificial intelligence (AI) can help with this. AI tools can be used to automatically detect faces and recognize them in real-time. This is like having a super-smart camera that can watch and understand everything happening in front of it. By integrating these AI features into a web application, we can automate the process of identifying threats and analyzing security. This way, we can save a lot of manpower and reduce costs, making the system more efficient and reliable.

slides.title:
Security First
Robust authentication and authorization protocols to protect sensitive data.
slides.narration:
{
  "narration": "On this slide, we talk about something called 'Security First.' This means we need to make sure that only the right people have access to important information. It's like when you have a secret, and you only share it with your best friends. We do this by using something called 'authentication' and 'authorization.' Authentication is like saying 'Who are you?' and 'Is it really you?' Authorization is like saying 'Can you do this?' and 'Can you do that?' We use different ways to do this, like checking your email or using a password that has lots of numbers and letters mixed together. We also use something called 'tokens' to make sure you're really who you say you are. This helps keep sensitive information safe and stops bad people from getting it."

slides.title:
🛡️ Multi-tier Login & Role-based Permissions
🛡️ Email Authentication & Supreme User Auth
🛡️ Sha256 Encrypted Passwords
🛡️ Token-based API Security
🛡️ Encrypted Communication & Data Sanitization
🛡️Usage of RESTful API
slides.narration: On this slide, we're talking about how we make sure only the right people can use our system, like a superhero suit for the internet. First up, we have email authentication, which is like checking if someone has the right password to get in. Then, we use something called SHA-256 to scramble passwords really well, so even if someone tries really hard, they can't break it. After that, we use tokens—like a magic key that lets you in—and we make sure all the data is sent in a secret way that can't be read by anyone who shouldn't see it. Finally, we use something called RESTful APIs, which are like special doorways that let different parts of the system talk to each other. Together, these steps help keep our system secure and only let the right people in, just like how a school gatekeeper lets only the right students in the right time.

Market Gap:
Current dependence on inefficient manual manpower is costly. Our Edge AI solution transitions from labor-heavy to technology-driven security, ensuring higher profitability and precision.
slides.narration: On this slide, we see who our target customers are and why our Edge AI solution is a great fit for them. First, we have Law Enforcement & Police Officers. They rely heavily on manual patrols, which can be costly and time-consuming. Our solution automates the process, saving them time and money. Next, we have Defense Research (DRDO) & Government Agencies. These organizations often use outdated systems, which can lead to security vulnerabilities. Our technology provides a more reliable and efficient way to protect their sensitive data. Finally, we look at Large-scale Commercial Spaces (Malls, Hubs). These places need to ensure the safety of their customers and employees. Our system allows for automated monitoring and reduces risks, making them more secure and profitable. Overall, our solution helps these groups transition from inefficient manual methods to a technology-driven approach, ensuring higher precision and cost savings.
